-- Red Bull Jukebox (2024) - Large-scale live event with CNC fabrication
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'live event design, Red Bull, experiential design, Lumenati, CNC fabrication, LED integration'
WHERE title = 'Red Bull Jukebox';

-- Add display tags
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (name, slug) VALUES 
  ('Live Event', 'live-event'),
  ('CNC Fabrication', 'cnc-fabrication'),
  ('LED Integration', 'led-integration'),
  ('2024', '2024');

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Red Bull Jukebox'
  AND t.slug IN ('live-event', 'cnc-fabrication', 'led-integration', 'lumenati', '2024')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );
